item.description: Glycosylation is a prevalent post-translational modification in the human brain, but its genetic regulation remains poorly defined. item.description: Nine in ten drug programmes that enter clinical trials fail, mostly for lack of efficacy1,2. item.description: BACKGROUND: Estrogen is thought to be neuroprotective; however, estrogen drops during menopause.
